versions.content: Support hardware descriptions from several sources Type: valid Description: The ECU Resource template shall provide means to combine the hardware descriptions from several sources. Rationale: The different partners in AUTOSAR supplying hardware can contribute their hardware descriptions. The hardware integrator can utilize the individual hardware descriptions to deliver the complete hardware description. Use Case: The microcontroller vendor provides an ECU Resource Description for the microcontroller. The ECU vendor creates an ECU Resource Description for the ECU and uses the ECU Resource Description for the microcontroller from the microcontroller vendor. Dependencies: – Supporting Material: –
